headline: Lcc Infotech submits statement of deviation or variation under Regulation 32
hook: Procedural compliance filing from Lcc Infotech
summary: Lcc Infotech Limited has formally informed the stock exchange regarding the statement of deviation or variation under Regulation 32. This regulatory filing details any changes in the utilization of funds raised through public issues, rights issues, or preferential issues. Retail investors holding the stock should note this is a standard compliance disclosure rather than a major operational event.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no direct impact on share price
